title: They want your whole backstory.
old_caption:
First pet, best day, biggest fear: they want your whole story. Too intense?
Curious is a compliment. Share at your own pace.

title: They laugh really loud.
old_caption:
Their laugh turns heads in a quiet café. Dealbreaker?
A big laugh is a big welcome. Give it a minute and you'll join in.

title: They cancel plans every time.
old_caption:
They've cancelled the last four plans. Still worth the skates?
Showing up matters. A kind no beats another last-minute sorry.

title: They brought a documentary to movie night.
old_caption:
Movie night, and they brought a documentary about moss. Dealbreaker?
Weird is a gift. Watch theirs, then they watch yours.

title: They already bought matching mittens.
old_caption:
They already bought you matching mittens. Too soon?
Warm hands, warm heart. Put them on.

title: Deep Dive: Aries in Love
old_caption:
Everything nobody tells you about loving an Aries, in four depths.
They flirt like a dare, fight fast and forgive by dinner. What keeps them: feeling chosen, out loud.

title: Deep Dive: Taurus in Love
old_caption:
Loving a Taurus is a slow dive, and worth every metre.
They need the same plan every week and calm over rushing. Give them time and they come back warmer.

title: Deep Dive: Gemini in Love
old_caption:
If a Gemini asks you forty questions, that's the flirt.
Give them room to change their mind, ask "joke, or real?" when it matters, and be their favourite person to talk to.

title: Deep Dive: Cancer in Love
old_caption:
"Did you eat?" is how a Cancer says I like you.
When the shell closes, don't pry. Stay close, say "no rush", and remember their little things back.

title: Deep Dive: Leo in Love
old_caption:
A Leo flirts at full beam and needs love said out loud.
In a fight, start with what you love, then the problem. Be their biggest fan and they'll be yours.
